name: The Demon, Lilith
source:
You embark upon your final task.

You are tracking a great beast, a creature of legend. You hunt this creature alone. You will return with its head, or you have failed. Through desolate and lifeless lands, you spend each day traversing the unknown in search of this beast.

But each night, as you sleep, a beautiful and mysterious woman appears in your dreams, her seductive charm threatening to distract you from your quest...

[From [url=https://inlustria.itch.io/the-demon-lilith]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你开始执行最后的任务。

你正在追踪一只伟大的野兽，一只传说中的生物。你独自狩猎这个生物。你将会带着它的头回来，否则你就失败了。在荒凉、死气沉沉的土地上，你每天都在未知的地方寻找这只野兽。

但每天晚上，当你入睡时，一位美丽而神秘的女人会出现在你的梦中，她诱人的魅力可能会分散你的注意力……

[来自[url=https://inlustria.itch.io/the-demon-lilith]Itch.io[/url]]
